Not sure where to start? Contact our Sales team to determine the best plan for your business. Contact us Contact us Start with 50€ free Start with 50€ free FAQs Can I try Gladia for free? Yes. New accounts get 50€ in free credits, valid for one year. That's roughly 312 hours of async transcription on solaria-3, 185 hours on solaria-1, or 73 hours of real-time. Once used, top up to continue, or get in touch for a demo . What are the billing options? Gladia runs on a prepaid credit wallet. You can top up manually, or set auto top-up to refill when your balanc ... led payments, so there are no end-of-month surprises. What is auto top-up? Auto top-up adds credits to your wallet when your balance drops below a threshold you set, charging your existing payment method. You can change the threshold or the amount, or turn it off, from your billing settings at any time. What are top-up bonuses? When you top up 1,000€ or more, we add free credits: +10% at 1,000€, +15% at 2,500€, and +20% at 5,000€ and above. Top-up credits never expire. Are there set up fees or hidden costs? No. Core features like custom vocabulary are included in every request. Add-ons such as summarization or translation are billed per hour only when you enable them, at the rates listed on this page . Do you offer volume discounts? Yes, automatically. Your hourly async ra ... , contact our sales team . Can I cancel at any time? Self-serve runs on prepaid credits with no subscription, so there's nothing to cancel. The Enterprise plan follows its contract terms. Is speech-to-text priced per minute or per hour? Both units are in common use, which makes providers hard to compare. Gladia publishes per-hour rates starting at 0.16€ an hour for async transcription (Solaria-3) and 0.68€ an hour for real-time streaming on the Self-serve plan. In per-minute terms that is 0.0027€ and 0.0113€ a minute. Does real-time transcription cost more than pre-recorded? Yes, at every provider. Real-time holds a live connection open and returns results as the audio arrives. On Gladia, real-time is 0.68€ an hour against 0.16€ (Solaria-3) for async transcription on Self-serve. Where a delay of a few minutes is acceptable, async is the cheaper path. What are the concurrency limits on each plan? The Self-serve plan allows 30 concurrent real-time sessions and 25 concurrent pre-recorded jobs. Enterprise removes the concurrency limits. Requests above the limit receive a 429
